notes: Ahah and MeGusta duplicate category/locale captures were collapsed only when key attributes agreed; Supérette products use retailer SKU to avoid 15 identity-hash collisions between distinct variants.
The checked-in identity registry preserves opaque UUIDv4 product IDs. Do not regenerate it for routine catalogue updates.

No cross-retailer records were merged because no shared validated GTIN or exact normalized name with a known, non-empty matching package size was available. The only exact name match without package metadata is Graines de Chia; Supérette exposes multiple variable-weight options, so the records remain separate rather than risking a false match.
Retailer price observations remain separate, attributed to store and location; no averages or synthetic national prices are calculated.
GTIN strings have spreadsheet decimal suffixes removed and GS1 Modulo-10 check digits validated. Retailer SKUs remain separate and store-scoped.
Invalid scraped brand values such as 'Poids …' and values equal to the store name are retained as raw metadata, not promoted to product brands.
Each source listing retains category paths, alternate URLs, source IDs, enrichment diagnostics, and source price/availability metadata.
